metadata.title: Does SurveyMind's Synthetic Data Actually Think Like a Human?
metadata.note: Human side of the underlying data is REAL (Open Psychometrics, n=603,322); synthetic side is a self-generated dummy stand-in, since real SurveyMind output was never found on GitHub. This week: attempted to regenerate synthetic data via the paper's own method (Gaussian copula, Section 4.2.1), got partway through, hit a blocker. FIXED 2026-09-26: B00/B07 ClaudeComposerAsk were defaulting to @NikBearBrown folder chip (never set folderLabel explicitly) — now explicitly set to @HumanitariansAI. B08 swapped from ClaudeTitleOutro to OutroCTA: ClaudeTitleOutro is hardcoded to @NikBearBrown/Liam mascot per its own component source comment ("claude-liam / @NikBearBrown reels ONLY... HARDCODED — no prop, no lookup, no override") and cannot be reskinned for HAI at all. Also removed stale sparse_by_design QC waivers on B02/B03/B04/B05/B06 now that they have real rendered content, so GATE V actually evaluates them instead of skipping the check.
